gaps.explanation: Gap 20,000 = Debt Service Fund 'Income for bonds' 20,000. The governmental funds statement (p5) prints it in the Debt Service Fund column as revenue 'Other' 20,000 (Debt Service total revenues 85,793; Total Governmental Funds Other 76,260, total revenues 1,013,928 incl. Transfer in 3,998 -> statement revenue 1,009,930). The Debt Service Fund budget schedule (p27) prints the same 20,000 below Total receipts 65,793 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES 'Income for bonds', and detail[] records it there (section other financing). The two printed statements classify the same money differently (revenue vs other financing source); detail 989,930 + 20,000 = 1,009,930. Nothing missing or duplicated; adding a revenue line would count the 20,000 twice.
